title: 抽牌预览 (Draw Peek)
description:
中文
抽牌预览 (Draw Peek) · 作者：wuxingogo · v1.8.2

战斗抽牌预览：悬停顶部计时器左侧的卡牌图标，横排查看当前抽牌堆中最多 5 张已确定的牌，无额外文字。暂停重新洗牌预测；不足时不补牌或卡背，空牌堆收起牌面。实际洗牌完成后显示新牌序。点击固定/取消固定。抽牌及相关结算时隐藏牌面，完成后刷新；暂停等菜单隐藏预览并保留固定状态。

地图起手预览：选点时也可悬停或固定顶部抽牌图标，查看下一场基础起手；由抽牌预览开关控制。按当前牌组模拟初始洗牌、固有/沉底优先级和已支持遗物的抽牌数量。先悬停战斗节点可计入精英起手加成。途中牌组变化、开场生成牌、自动打出、换牌及特殊洗牌可能改变结果。

地图预测：悬停当前可前往的未走过节点，查看预计房间、战斗金币/药水/卡牌、精英遗物和宝箱遗物。事件显示名称、初始选项及效果说明；无宝箱奖励时显示“奖励：空箱子”。商店与休息处仅显示用途。

事件卡牌预测：
• 随机升级：悬停光暗之门、无尽传送带、真理石碑、镜像事件的受支持选项，在按钮旁查看卡牌图像。
• 随机变化：进入选牌界面后悬停目标牌，查看变化结果；多张按选择顺序预测，只有一个合法目标时也可直接在事件按钮旁显示。支持 Aroma of Chaos、Morphic Grove、Symbiote、Whispering Hollow、Endless Conveyor、Trial 的标准变化选项。
• 被寄生的自动机械：悬停“研究”预览随机能力牌；悬停“触摸核心”预览随机 0 费牌。

设置：模组设置与 RitsuLib 设置共用配置，Ctrl+Shift+F9 打开后选择 Draw Peek。“抽牌预览”“地图预测”“事件预测”独立控制，自动保存，无需重启。新配置默认全开，旧配置缺失的新开关沿用原开关状态。

语言：界面自动跟随游戏语言，中文使用简体中文，其他语言使用英文；卡牌、事件和奖励名称采用游戏本地化。

预测使用随机数与卡牌副本，不执行事件选项、不推进真实随机数或改变牌组。结果基于当前状态；继续出牌、敌方/抽牌触发、联机共享随机数消耗、奖励替换及其他模组可能改变结果。先战斗后升级、第三方事件及第三方卡牌不在当前事件预测范围。

依赖与兼容：最低目标游戏版本 v0.107.1；必需 RitsuLib 0.6.9 或以上、且与所用游戏版本兼容。RandomForeseer 为可选增强依赖。

English
Draw Peek · Author: wuxingogo · v1.8.2

Combat draw preview: hover the card icon left of the top timer to see up to five known cards in the current draw pile in one row. Reshuffle prediction is suspended; short piles get no extra cards or backs, and empty piles hide the row. Previews resume after the real shuffle. Click to pin/unpin. Faces hide during draw and related resolution, then refresh. Modal menus preserve pinning.

Map opening hand: hover or pin the top-bar draw icon while choosing nodes to preview the next combat base hand, controlled by Draw Peek. Uses the current deck, initial shuffle, innate/bottom priority, and supported relic draw counts. Hover a combat node first to include elite opening bonuses. Deck changes, generated cards, auto-play, redraws, and special shuffles may change results.

Map predictions: hover unvisited, reachable nodes to preview room types, combat gold/potions/cards, elite relics, and chest relics. Events show their names, initial choices, and descriptions. Empty chests show “Reward: Empty chest”. Shops and rest sites show their purpose only.

Event card predictions:
• Random upgrades: hover supported choices in Doors of Light and Dark, Endless Conveyor, Tablet of Truth, and Reflections to see card images beside the button.
• Random transforms: hover a target in the selection screen to preview its replacement. Multiple transforms follow selection order; a single legal target can also be previewed beside the event button. Supports standard options in Aroma of Chaos, Morphic Grove, Symbiote, Whispering Hollow, Endless Conveyor, and Trial.
• Infested Automaton: hover Study for the predicted Power, or Touch Core for the predicted zero-cost card.

Settings: mod settings and RitsuLib settings share the Draw Peek page. Open it with Ctrl+Shift+F9. Draw Peek, Map Predictions, and Event Predictions have independent toggles, saved automatically without restarting. New configurations enable all three; missing toggles in older settings inherit the previous toggle state.

Language: UI follows the game language. Chinese locales use Simplified Chinese; other locales use English. Card, event, and reward names use game localization.

Predictions use cloned RNG and cards without executing event choices, advancing live RNG, or changing the deck. Further plays, enemy/on-draw effects, shared multiplayer RNG, reward replacements, and other mods may change outcomes. Upgrades after combat, third-party events, and third-party cards are outside the current event prediction scope.

Requirements: minimum target game version v0.107.1. Requires RitsuLib 0.6.9 or later, compatible with your game version. RandomForeseer is an optional enhancement.

v1.6.0: Added pinnable next-combat base opening hand previews on the map, preserving live deck order and RNG.
v1.5.2: Added Infested Automaton Power/zero-cost previews.
v1.5.1: Added independent map/event toggles and migration of older settings.
v1.5.0: Added event upgrade/transformation card-image previews.
v1.4.2: Removed the event option footer; empty chests display “Reward: Empty chest”.
v1.4.1: Added initial event option names and descriptions to map previews.
v1.4.0: Adapted RNG, potion rewards, and combat card interfaces for game v0.107.1.

v1.3.0: Added Chinese and English UI following the game language.
